This fabrication directly caused the calculation of incorrect distances and the selection of the wrong cities.

hypotheses.rationale: This is the decisive error because the agent admitted to an inability to access external data ('can't directly access the content') and chose to fabricate/hypothetical data rather than reporting the failure or admitting ignorance. This false data led to incorrect coordinate calculations (identifying Yorba Linda instead of the actual westernmost birthplace, Galena, IL) and a failure to follow the sorting instruction (the selected cities were not alphabetically sorted in the output). Subsequent steps merely propagated this fabricated reality.
